get.summary: Get quotes generated in the current month
get.description: Retrieves data on quotes generated during the current month

Returns the manufacturer analytics dashboard in one call, including revenue, funnel, production, customer and material insights. Use this endpoint for reporting dashboards and external BI syncs that need the same aggregates shown in the manufacturer app. The response is scoped to the authenticated operator. Supply a `period` preset or an explicit `from`/`to` range, which wins over `period`. Aggregation is computed at the database level. All period math is in UTC. The `funnel` section returns three stage lists over the quotes-created-in-window cohort - `acquisition` (visits -> sign-ups -> first order), `quoteToOrder` (quote opened -> accepted -> order created) and `fulfillment` (order created -> production started -> production completed -> order completed) - each stage carrying drop-off counts/conversions and median/p95 days from the previous stage, so you can see where flow is lost and where it slows down. Transition times come from the audit trail, so later edits do not rewrite history; order completion is a kanban state and is reported count-only.

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Preset reporting window. Defaults to `last_30_days` when omitted. Ignored when both `from` and `to` are supplied.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Explicit reporting window start date in `yyyy-MM-dd` format. Together with `to`, overrides `period`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Explicit reporting window end date in `yyyy-MM-dd` format, inclusive. Together with `from`, overrides `period`.

parameters.name: granularity
parameters.description: Time-series bucket granularity. Auto-derived from the requested window when omitted.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Dashboard sections to compute. Repeat the query parameter for multiple sections, e.g. `sections=revenue&sections=funnel`. All sections are returned when omitted.

parameters.name: customerType
parameters.description: Optional dimension filter by customer type.

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: Optional dimension filter by order source.

parameters.name: compare
parameters.description: When true, include a compact `previous` block (equal-length prior window) of KPI scalars for period-over-period deltas. Ignored for all_time.

parameters.name: includeArchived
parameters.description: When true, include archived orders in every count/sum. Defaults to false so the dashboard reflects only live, active orders.

400.description: Invalid range (e.g. too many buckets, or `to` before `from`)

quoteToOrderOutbound.description: Outbound/manufacturer-sent quote-to-order funnel. Present only when no source filter is active.

materialProcessMatrix.description: Revenue grouped by material and technology.
